title: The Winter Harbor
premise: In the snowbound port town of Vellamare, apprentice mapmaker Lior Villalobos inherits his dead master's forbidden atlas — a chart of coastal defenses and hidden channels that the Crown's surveyors want burned and foreign agents want stolen. When winter closes the bridge and garrison officers arrive to seize the workshop, Lior must choose between destroying the atlas to save himself or completing its final plate, which could guide an invasion fleet through the harbor ice. He finishes it in secret, then alters one crucial soundings line so the fleet would founder on the shoals, sacrificing the master's perfect truth for the town's survival. The book ends with him burning the original plate as the bridge reopens, keeping only a blank sheet — a mapmaker with no map, finally free.
about_author: Marguerite Nakamura is a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing sixteenth-century portolan charts before turning to fiction. She writes from a coastal town where the tide charts still dictate the rhythm of daily life.

chapters.title: The Weight of Paper
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Weeks after Master Aldric's death, Lior secretly works on the atlas's final plate while pretending to inventory the workshop for the guild. He discovers Aldric's marginal notes revealing the atlas charts the harbor's military soundings — knowledge worth killing for. When a garrison courier arrives announcing the bridge closes at first snow, Lior realizes he is trapped inside the very thing everyone wants. Emotional beat: dread disguised as diligence.

chapters.title: What the Ice Allows
chapters.summary: Lior's POV, interwoven with letters from Captain Sera Ives, the officer sent to inventory the workshop. Sera is not the brute he expected; she quotes Aldric's old lectures and seems to be stalling her own superiors. Their wary alliance deepens over shared meals while the first snow seals the bridge. But Lior finds her sealed orders: the workshop burns when the thaw comes. Emotional beat: tenderness blooming inside betrayal's shadow.

chapters.title: The Final Plate
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Racing the thaw, Lior completes the last plate by candlelight while Sera covers for him against a suspicious lieutenant. A foreign agent breaks in seeking the soundings; in the struggle the workshop catches fire, and they save the atlas together but lose half of Aldric's papers. Holding the finished plate, Lior understands that completing it perfectly means handing an invading fleet the harbor's throat. Emotional beat: love and duty colliding at the point of a compass.

chapters.title: Blank Sheet
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. At the bridge reopening, Sera must report the atlas destroyed in the fire — a lie she chooses over her orders. Lior has engraved one false sounding into the final plate and buried it where only someone who reads maps like Aldric taught would ever find it, then burns the true plate in the harbor tide. Walking across the open bridge with nothing but his tools, he is no longer an apprentice carrying another man's work. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into freedom.
